The square is currently at (18-19, 0-1), touching the left edge. The 4th click was at (19,0), and the square moved from (19,0) to (18,0) — wait, let me trace it: before the batch, the square's top-left was (19,0)? No, that's wrong.

So from (19,0) to (18,0): it moved only up (the column was clamped at 0). So at the left edge, the square moves vertically upward. It's heading toward the top bar!
So the movement is: the square moves toward the top-left, and at the edge it slides along the edge. If I keep clicking, it will reach the top bar (rows 0-9). The black segment is rows 0-3, columns 0-15. The square will end up at (1-2, 0-1)? Or does it get absorbed?
Wait, but the palette's S square is at (1-2, 1-2)! The square is at (18,0) and moving up along column 0. If it reaches (1,0), it will be adjacent to the S palette square at (1,1). Hmm.
So the goal might be: move each of the 4 magenta squares into the top bar, and they line up in the black segment next to the palette squares? The black segment is 4 wide (columns 0-15), and there are 4 palette squares at columns 1-2, 5-6, 9-10, 13-14.
Or maybe the squares get absorbed into the top bar, and the level completes when all 4 have been absorbed.
Let me keep clicking the square at (18,0) to move it up. About 16 more clicks to reach row 1. Let me batch 16 clicks at (17,0), (16,0), …, (2,0).
